RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Greensboro, NC operates under a Council-Manager form of government, which is categorized as 'mayor_council' for this response. The Mayor and three Council members are elected at-large, and five Council members are elected from districts. Elections are non-partisan and held in odd years. This list reflects the current elected officials as of September 2025. Some officials have indicated they will not seek re-election in the upcoming 2025 elections.
